resources.string: At the PC, in the Helper: PCs → "Add a device by pairing". Then search here.
Find Helper in the network
Searching …
No Helper found. Is pairing mode on at the Helper? Otherwise enter the address below.
Pair with %1$s (%2$s)
Connecting to the Helper …
Compare this number with the one at the Helper „%1$s“ and click „Allow“ there:
Only if both numbers are the same: “Allow” there and “Number matches” here. Waiting up to 5 minutes.
Number matches
Waiting for “Allow” at the Helper …
Allowed at the Helper. Tap “Number matches” if both numbers are the same.
This Helper is too old for pairing without the code (needs 0.5.2). Update it or enter the pairing code below.
Too many pairing attempts. Wait a few minutes and start pairing mode at the Helper again.
Cancel
The Helper declined the pairing.
Pairing expired. Start pairing mode at the Helper again.
The Helper is not in pairing mode.
Or by hand: address of the PC, with the pairing code or with the number to compare.
Without code
The clocks of phone and PC differ by more than 10 minutes. Set the time automatically on both.
Name of this device
Shown in the device list of the Helper. Empty: NovaBird and the model name.
